tut.1: Tap a customer to take their order.
tut.2: Stretch the dough: scroll the wheel or tap the arrow keys.
tut.3: Pick the topping they want, then put it on the pizza.
tut.4: Load the pizza. Click or press Space when the marker is in the green.
tut.5: Tap the finished pizza to hand it over.
tut.6: Nice! Spend some cash in the Shop.
tut.7: Hire a cashier so orders run themselves.
tut.done: Tutorial complete. Your stand is on its own now!
mini.dough.title: Stretch the dough
mini.dough.hint: Scroll the mouse wheel or tap the left and right arrow keys. Touch: swipe.
mini.top.title: Add topping
mini.top.hint: Click a topping, then click the pizza. Keys 1 to 3 pick, Space places.
mini.oven.title: Slide it in
mini.oven.hint: Click or press Space when the marker is in the green.
toast.ovenFull: Oven is full. Wait for a slot.
event.rainyDay.name: Rainy day
event.rainyDay.desc: More customers, but they are in a hurry.

collect.title: Welcome back!
franchise.title: Franchise your stand
franchise.explain: Start again from scratch and keep permanent bonuses. Each franchise adds +{bonus}% cash and +{traffic}% customers for good, and your place grows: cart, then a big stand, then a pizza shop with more staff. Every franchise has to be earned again, and each one needs more than the last.
franchise.resets: Resets: cash, upgrades, staff, queue, pizzas, and you go back to the corner.
franchise.keeps: Keeps: franchise points, unlocked pizza styles (recipes), unlocked locations, the tutorial, settings, and lifetime stats.
franchise.locked: Earn {target} at this stand to franchise. So far: {have}.
